title: Benefits to Singapore from Setting Up of Singapore-Shanghai Comprehensive Cooperation Council
what_it_is: Benefits to Singapore from Setting Up of Singapore-Shanghai Comprehensive Cooperation Council

sections.label: Singapore-Shanghai cooperation council agreements
sections.summary: The SSCCC, established in 2019, has signed 37 agreements across six areas, including a joint innovation call with over 50 applications.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Established in 2019, the SSCCC continues to enhance cooperation between Singapore and Shanghai.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Thus far, 37 agreements have been signed to promote collaboration across the six areas of financial services, technology and innovation, urban governance, people-to-people exchanges, ease of doing business, and the Belt and Road Initiative.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Notable partnerships include the establishment of the Singapore-China YRD Joint Innovation Call, which has received over 50 project applications from Singapore companies embarking on joint innovation projects with partners in Shanghai and the greater YRD region.

sections.label: IMDA Shanghai MOU digital cooperation
sections.summary: At the fourth SSCCC meeting, IMDA and Shanghai's economy commission signed an MOU on digital connectivity, utilities and innovation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: For example, at the fourth SSCCC meeting held in Singapore last month, Singapore's Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) and the Shanghai Municipal Economy and Informatization Commission signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to explore initiatives in digital connectivity, digital utilities and innovation.

sections.label: UnionPay cross-border QR payments
sections.summary: UnionPay International is partnering with DBS and OCBC to let Singapore customers make QR payments at over 40 million merchants globally.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: In the area of financial services, Shanghai-headquartered UnionPay International is partnering with Singapore banks, such as DBS and OCBC Bank, to facilitate cross-border payments, which will allow their customers in Singapore to make UnionPay QR Code payments at over 40 million merchants globally.

sections.label: Singapore-Shanghai trade and investment
sections.summary: In 2022, Singapore-Shanghai trade rose 8% to RMB100 billion; Singapore was Shanghai's largest foreign investor.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: For example, last year, in 2022, total trade between Singapore and Shanghai increased 8% year-on-year to RMB100 billion.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: In terms of investment, Singapore was Shanghai's largest foreign investor last year, while Shanghai is Singapore's second largest investment destination in the People's Republic of China (PRC) as of end 2021.

sections.label: SSCCC agreements despite pandemic
sections.summary: The Member is assured that despite three pandemic years, the SSCCC facilitated 37 agreements since its setup four years ago.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: I want to assure the Member that since the SSCCC was set up four years ago, and out of the past four years, for three years we were mired in the COVID-19 pandemic.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: And despite that, we managed to facilitate the inking of 37 agreements.

sections.label: First Singapore-China securities joint venture
sections.summary: In 2021 during the pandemic, the first Singapore-China Securities Joint Venture was set up, with DBS underwriting onshore securities.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: A quick example, in 2021, even during the COVID-19 pandemic, the first Singapore-China Securities Joint Venture company was set up, which then saw DBS underwriting and trading onshore securities products.
